market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Dow futures down 300 points on oil spike. August CPI data creates binary risk. Trade war escalation adds noise. Yen rally pressures Japanese equities. Expect 5-8% volatility in energy and FX. Retail selling (Robinhood data) vs. institutional bullishness creates divergence risk.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure capex cycle intact (TSMC, ASML, SLB). Defense spending structural. Energy transition (storage, biofuels) creates new growth vectors. India capital markets maturation. Social Security fiscal risk is 3-5 year overhang. $100 oil normalizes if Hormuz stabilizes.
